description:
Take one video out of a folder; the hook or find and its keep stay. Returns
    {"item_id", "removed": true}. Same as DELETE /v1/folders/{folder_id}/items/{item_id}.
    Free. Errors: 404 item_not_found (also on a second remove).

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

item_id.description: an item of that folder (from get_folder or save_to_folder)
item_id.title: Item Id

name: remove_from_folder
